alt: Poster: Sensex 81,879.40 (+0.95%), Nifty 50 25,255.05 (+0.84%), Nifty Smallcap 100 +1.6% on 11 Nov 2026; IT, pharma and realty ended lower
text:
Indian equities gained on 11 Nov, the first session after the Diwali holiday, with the Sensex up 0.95% and the Nifty 50 up 0.84%, led by banking and broader-market buying.

• The Sensex closed at 81,879.40 and the Nifty 50 at 25,255.05, up 0.95% and 0.84% respectively, per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky closing reports.
• The Nifty Smallcap 100 rose about 1.6% and the Nifty Midcap 100 about 0.8%, per the same reports.
• Nifty Bank and Nifty PSU Bank advanced, while Nifty IT, Pharma and Realty ended lower, per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky.
• HDFC Sky attributes the firmer sentiment to softer crude oil prices and strong foreign fund inflows.

Our view: smallcaps and midcaps rising faster than the benchmarks suggests participation was broad on the day, though a single session says little about direction. Sector divergence, with banks up and IT down, is a reminder that index levels can hide very different moves underneath. This is an interpretation of one day's data, not a prediction.

For practitioners: when benchmarks and broader indices move together after a holiday break, do you read it as genuine breadth or mainly as catch-up buying?
